note: All five companies are fictional demo businesses made up for this app.

floors.name: Tidewatch Surf Notes
floors.tagline: A weekly beach-cafe board: what the sea is doing and what to put on the menu.
floors.brief: Tidewatch Surf Notes writes one weekly board for a small beach cafe: expected swell and tide windows in plain words, plus two menu specials that suit the weather. The owner is a former lifeguard who wants it friendly, short, and never a safety guarantee.
floors.task: Write this week's board for a week with a long, gentle swell and low tide at midday.
floors.ownerRole: Owner: ex-lifeguard, approves anything that sounds like safety advice.

floors.name: Stitchwise Repairs
floors.tagline: Mending guides and quotes for people who would rather fix than replace.
floors.brief: Stitchwise Repairs is a one-person clothing repair shop. Agents draft care and mending guides and reply to quote requests from the owner's own price list: patch 12, hem 9, zip 18 (currency units per item). The owner decides on exceptions and rush jobs.
floors.task: Reply to a customer who asks what it costs to fix a torn jacket zip and a frayed hem, and when it could be ready.
floors.ownerRole: Owner: tailor, approves any price outside the list.

floors.name: Kimchi Club
floors.tagline: A monthly newsletter for people learning to ferment at home.
floors.brief: Kimchi Club sends one newsletter a month to home fermenters: one recipe idea, one troubleshooting tip, and one reader question answered. The owner is a home cook who wants a warm, practical tone and no medical claims.
floors.task: Write the newsletter for a month where readers keep asking why their jar smells too sour.
floors.ownerRole: Owner: home cook, approves anything about food safety.

floors.name: Lantern Tutors
floors.tagline: Short lesson plans for tutors who teach evening classes.
floors.brief: Lantern Tutors writes 30-minute lesson plans for volunteer tutors who teach adults basic maths in the evening. Plans must be concrete: warm-up, one worked example, two practice questions, a closing check. The owner is a retired teacher.
floors.task: Write a lesson plan for percentages, for adults who are nervous about maths.
floors.ownerRole: Owner: retired teacher, approves the level and the examples.

floors.name: Night Owl Bakery
floors.tagline: Pre-orders and a daily post for a bakery that opens after midnight.
floors.brief: Night Owl Bakery bakes between midnight and dawn for shift workers. Agents turn the day's pre-orders into a bake list and write the day's short social post. The owner decides what to cap when ingredients run low.
floors.task: Turn these pre-orders into a bake list and a short post: 14 sourdough, 9 cardamom buns, 6 rye, flour for about 30 loaves.
floors.ownerRole: Owner: head baker, decides what to cap when flour is short.
